Reddits best content is always inside subreddits that focused on informative or stimulating conversation, its rarely the content of the original post itself that got things going, its almost always the conversation happening in the comments or the direct replies to a question that attracts knowledgeable and reasonable people willing to engage in conversation. Anything that encourages this should be welcomed by Reddit users who want to get away from the freeapproved speech loving admins / moderators.

Reddits biggest problem was always the misuse of upvoting or downvoting as agreement / disagreement buttons that end up hiding opposing conversations and points of views relevant to the topic of conversation, you might say "well that person can always set up their own subreddit" and youre right, some of them do set up their subreddits and attract like minded individuals but all that really does is create tribal echo chambers that sometimes results in brigading and subreddit invasions, even worse it resulted in upvote / downvote bots which aggressively shaped the contents of subreddits or attacked certain users. Its better to encourage self moderation than give egotistic fools the chance to be an authority on absolutely everything. Try playing devils advocate on any topic in any popular subreddit and you'll get downvoted to oblivion by people with virtually no replies just because you are entertaining an opposing point of view.

You've got to remember having a voice doesn't mean people have to listen to you, it does mean you are welcome to voice your opinion but you have no guarantees your opinion will carry any weight so why should everyone have the chance to shape a topic of conversation from the outside?
